notes.title: Update 0.1.7 - Dynamic Lighting
notes.content: [h1]v0.1.7-beta[/h1][p][b]This update brings new dynamic lighting FX that dramatically enhance the atmosphere![/b] [/p][p]Weapons and items now interact with the environment through real-time light emission - like muzzle flashes, fire, and explosions. New items have been introduced to take full advantage of the lighting system, making gameplay feel more intense and immersive.[/p][h3]Night Vision  [/h3][list][*][p]Available as a new default equipment item (available for all classes)[/p][/*][*][p]Always available in Operations (press [b]N[/b])[/p][/*][/list][h3]Flashlight  [/h3][list][*][p]Available as a new weapon attachment[/p][/*][*][p]Customizable color (just like the Laser attachment)[/p][/*][*][p]Toggle by pressing [b]T[/b][/p][/*][/list][h3]Night Mode[/h3][list][*][p]Sets the map very dark - [b]Flashlights + Night Vision are essential[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Combine with Hardcore mode for a challenge![/p][/*][/list][h2]Battlezone Updates  [/h2][list][*][p]Added [b]Hostages[/b] for extra loot rewards[/p][/*][*][p][b]Extraction Helicopter[/b] now armed with rockets[/p][/*][*][p]New enemies[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed map ladder positions[/p][/*][/list][h2]Other Notes [/h2][list][*][p]Updated [b]Zombie Survival[/b] player loadout[/p][/*][*][p]Increased [b]ACR 6.8[/b] damage[/p][/*][*][p]Bot improvements[/p][/*][*][p]Added chat text limit[/p][/*][*][p]Other UI/bug fixes[/p][/*][/list][p][/p]

notes.title: Update 0.1.6 - Battlezone
notes.content: [h1]v0.1.6-beta [/h1][p]This update includes the first revision of [b]Battlezone[/b], a new extraction game mode where players can loot credits and XP!  [/p][h2]Battlezone Overview  [/h2][list][*][p][b]Multiplayer only[/b] - recommended for experienced players[/p][/*][*][p]Massive randomly generated map[/p][/*][*][p]Full day/night cycle with dynamic weather[/p][/*][*][p]Mercenary airdrops of different factions who fight each other[/p][/*][*][p]Zombies and Infestors come out during the night[/p][/*][*][p]Keep an eye out for the Extraction Helicopter to deposit your loot[/p][/*][*][p]Random crates and objects can be destroyed to find weapons, ammo, loot, or enemies[/p][/*][/list][h2]Other Notes[/h2][list][*][p]Characters can now jump while sliding[/p][/*][*][p]Increased character mantle distance[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted [b].50 BMG[/b] sniper rifle damages[/p][/*][*][p]Increased [b]AUG HBAR[/b] mobility[/p][/*][*][p]Increased lethality for [b]Zombie Spitters[/b] and [b]Zombie Spitter Bosses[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Added restart button for custom server multiplayer games[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed bug where [b]Claymores[/b] could be moved[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed weapon skin localizations[/p][/*][*][p]Editor updates[/p][/*][*][p]Other minor bug fixes[/p][/*][/list][h2]Early Access[/h2][p]The Early Access release is happening next month - make sure you add it to your Wishlist![/p][p][/p][p][url="https://discord.gg/B9vKMRz4ut"]Join the official Discord here[/url]![/p]

notes.title: Update 0.1.5
notes.content: [h1]v0.1.5-beta[/h1][p][/p][p]This update includes a highly-requested feature: [b]Custom Servers[/b]![/p][p][/p][h2]Create Server[/h2][p]You can now host a multiplayer server from within the game! Multiple regions are available. In addition to the Standard and Survival game modes, you can use these servers to play [b]Operations[/b] with teammates in multiplayer.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45352901/f859f9473739d01f58ab1fedbccf437f73bdd11e.png"][/img][/p][h2]Other Notes[/h2][list][*][p]Added [b]Jammer[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Railgun[/b] and [b]Deadswitch[/b] now available in the Tactical Crate[/p][/*][*][p][b]RC-XD[/b] is now available as a Support class equipment[/p][/*][*][p]Improved friendly [b]UGV[/b] in Survival (increased HP and harder to flip over)[/p][/*][*][p]Equipment can now be repaired with the [b]Repair Tool[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Added [b]money multiplier[/b] to Survival[/p][/*][*][p]New [b]Shadow Company[/b] soldier items[/p][/*][*][p]New Survival enemies (including [b]Dragonfire[/b] and [b]Reaper[/b])[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed money reward for Infestors[/p][/*][*][p]Other bug fixes[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]Discord[/h2][p][url="https://discord.gg/B9vKMRz4ut"]Remember to join the Discord[/url] to submit any feedback or suggestions![/p]

notes.title: Update 0.1.4
notes.content: [h1]v0.1.4-beta[/h1][p]This is a big update with a lot of new content![/p][p]While the Next Fest demo is no longer available, [url="https://discord.gg/B9vKMRz4ut"]you can get the latest build from the Discord server[/url]![/p][h2]Operations[/h2][p][b]Operations[/b] return from Deadswitch 3! Select a mission and set the difficulty (Novice, Hard, or Veteran) to earn rewards. [/p][p]Currently, all DS3 Operations are available (including the campaign) with unique DSC Operations coming in future updates.[/p][h2]Game of the Day[/h2][p]Earn more Credits by completing the [b]Game of the Day[/b]! [/p][p]A new game is generated every 24hr and is the same for all players.[/p][h2]New Weapons + Equipment[/h2][list][*][p][b]SCAR-12[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Taser[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Adrenaline[/b][/p][/*][/list][h2]New Vehicles + Support + Enemies[/h2][list][*][p][b]UGV[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]RC-XD[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Reaper[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Infestors[/b][/p][/*][/list][h2]Soldier Customization[/h2][list][*][p]New appearance items (like the [b]Ghillie[/b] suit and many more)[/p][/*][*][p]New [b]Callsigns[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Parachute[/b] color can now be customized[/p][/*][/list][h2]Editor[/h2][list][*][p]Added ability to show/hide layers[/p][/*][*][p]New objects[/p][/*][/list][h2]Other Notes[/h2][list][*][p]Added player spray paint ability (default [b]V[/b])[/p][/*][*][p][b]Challenges[/b] now show how many players have completed them[/p][/*][*][p]New stats: [b]Team Wipe[/b] and [b]Daily Game Events Completed[/b][/p][/*][*][p]New weapon skins[/p][/*][*][p][b]Repair Tool[/b] is now the default equipment for Engineer[/p][/*][*][p]Rebalanced Juggernauts (increased headshot damage)[/p][/*][*][p]Improved bot skill for VIP in Assassination[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed performance drop bug for extra long games[/p][/*][*][p]Lots of other UI and bug fixes[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Beta Testing
notes.content:
Are you interested in beta testing Deadswitch Combat before launch?

[b]The very first beta playtests are happening soon![/b]

Join the official Discord for more info: https://discord.gg/B9vKMRz4ut

[h2]FAQ[/h2]

[h3]What is Deadswitch Combat?[/h3]

Deadswitch Combat is a fast-paced 2D multiplayer shooter that builds upon the previous games in the series, particularly Deadswitch 3. If you've played any Deadswitch game in the past, you will already be familiar with most of the game mechanics.

[h3]What are some new mechanics introduced in Deadswitch Combat?[/h3]
[list]
[*] Built from the ground-up with a new game engine for optimal performance
[*] Revamped NPC AI
[*] Destructible environments
[*] Player-controlled vehicles (like ATVs, helicopters, and tanks)
[*] Much more expansive weapon customization, including weapon skins
[*] Lots of new factions and enemy types
[*] Cross-platform (controller support and mobile)
[*] Map editor, custom servers, and very mod-friendly
[/list]
[h3]How can I start beta testing?[/h3]

Join the Discord for important information regarding beta playtests! You can play the game on PC (via Steam) or even in your browser.

[h3]Can I make suggestions for the game?[/h3]

Yes! There is a dedicated suggestions channel in the official Discord server. All suggestions are welcome!
